description.en: A single-character scene where the subject speaks on-camera with dialogue synced to an audio track.
description.zh: 单人物场景，角色对镜头说话，口型与音轨同步。

useWhen.en: Use for talking-head content, monologues, testimonials, or any shot where synced speech drives the scene.
useWhen.zh: 用于口播、独白、证言类内容，或任何以同步语音驱动画面的镜头。

en: shot type + framing (close-up / medium)
subject description + wardrobe
setting + time of day + light quality
dialogue sync instruction (lip-sync to provided audio)
camera behavior (static / subtle handheld)
mood + tone descriptor
zh: shot type + framing (close-up / medium)
subject description + wardrobe
setting + time of day + light quality
dialogue sync instruction (lip-sync to provided audio)
camera behavior (static / subtle handheld)
mood + tone descriptor

en: Name the lip-sync requirement explicitly, do not assume it.
Keep camera movement subtle so the face stays legible for sync.
Describe light direction, not just brightness, to keep skin tones stable.
zh: 明确写出口型同步要求，不要默认模型会做。
镜头动作要克制，保证脸部清晰便于同步。
描述光的方向而不只是亮度，保持肤色稳定。

en: Over-describing background detail pulls focus from lip accuracy.
Fast cuts or camera whip breaks sync continuity.
zh: 背景描述太多会分散口型精度的注意力。
快切或甩镜会打断同步的连续性。

description.en: A studio product shot that orbits or reveals a single object with commercial-grade lighting.
description.zh: 工作室产品镜头，围绕或展示单一物体，配合商业级打光。

useWhen.en: Use for ads, e-commerce hero shots, or any single-product reveal that needs a polished, sellable look.
useWhen.zh: 用于广告、电商主图视频，或任何需要精致卖相的单品展示镜头。

en: product description + material detail
environment (seamless studio / context set)
camera move (orbit / push-in / rise)
lighting setup (key, rim, fill)
finishing detail (particles, reflections, shadow quality)
grade descriptor (commercial, clean, high-contrast)
zh: product description + material detail
environment (seamless studio / context set)
camera move (orbit / push-in / rise)
lighting setup (key, rim, fill)
finishing detail (particles, reflections, shadow quality)
grade descriptor (commercial, clean, high-contrast)

en: Specify the orbit direction and speed to avoid a jerky auto-generated path.
Call out material properties (matte, glossy, metallic) so reflections render correctly.
zh: 写清楚环绕方向和速度，避免自动生成路径卡顿。
点明材质属性（哑光/光面/金属），反射才会渲染正确。

en: Leaving the background undescribed often produces a generic gray void.
Too many camera moves in one shot fights the product-clarity goal.
zh: 不描述背景容易生成通用的灰色空场。
一个镜头里堆太多运镜会牺牲产品清晰度。
